items.title: Multiplicativity of the Chern character, with the precise binomial formula for the power sums of the Chern roots of a tensor product
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the Chern character is multiplicative on a tensor product of finite locally free modules, together with the precise identity expressing the power sums of the Chern roots of the tensor product as a binomial combination of those of the factors (statement lines 8985-9002). The proof is an application of the splitting principle: after naming the Chern roots, those of the tensor product are the pairwise sums, and the binomial formula together with the shape of the auxiliary polynomials gives the claim. The passage through the splitting principle and the matching of the coefficients are the substance, so the claim is H2.
